bootstrap.basis: 1.5×maximum full-support paired/season/year endpoint wall time×15808, plus1.5×full13-stream MCS elimination-chain wall time×8 and1.5×DM/GW wall time×208; four paired variants and secondary7-day stress, complete10000 draws; margin includes storage/validation; synthetic values only

failed_jobs_and_resume.basis: Preserved10% of every future priced component, including all42searches,all2441daily origins, analysis,persistence,operational startup,custody,report/review/closure. Actual failures and2826s historical reserve are already included once in the cumulative balance.

measured_replay_state_growth_supplement.basis: Supplement only: original retained replay allowance plus this row equals at least the measured-production remaining-growth bound. All earlier work is already in cumulative charges; no remaining date at/before the completed prefix is priced again by the new growth calculation.

operational_startup_supervision_and_cust.basis: Twelve future serial monitored stage/start/review/closure equivalents, each at the maximum whole 337s cold plan-preparation job allocation; includes startup/input context copies,supervision,ledger refresh and custody.
